laws.rule: Teniente Agripino Enciso National Park: MADES publishes daily 07:00 to 17:00 public visiting hours and a camping option. Access-road conditions depend on weather and rainfall. The camping option remains subject to park-designated areas and ranger instructions.

Defensores del Chaco National Park, extending into Alto Paraguay and Boquerón: arrange express MADES permission before entering. Visits to the absolute-protection zone require authorisation and ranger accompaniment; do not organise an unapproved expedition. The park page publishes no fixed public visiting hours and describes ranger-controlled access. Its camping option does not override protected-zone access restrictions.
